description:
Volleyball star Oh Leo never forgot his first love, Wu Eden. Years later, he follows a familiar melody into an ice rink, only to find the former figure skating prodigy herself. While Leo is all sunshine and relentless affection, Eden has built a cold wall around her heart. But during a private skating lesson, the ice begins to melt as she notices Leo's powerful, athletic physique. When a playful scuffle sends them sliding across the ice, Eden realizes Leo is carrying more than just a torch for her, he’s packing a "bat" that’s ready for the big leagues. Driven by sudden temptation, she lures him into the office to see if his stamina on the court translates to the sheets.

(Source: Lezhin US)
